scope: Three independent simulated-USB negative contracts: real legacy helper records must remain manual, current recovery permission must still allow persisted opt-in, and external C claims must not be taken. Legacy tail uses explicit administrator restoration/read-only reconcile; other tails require a new helper before product recovery and third real I/O. No hardware or FD revocation claim.

positive.before:
STAGE=kill-service
    start_ready killed
    send_control 192.0.2.2 cycle-2-ready
    receive_control cycle-2-io
    actual_pending
    cp /tmp/pending.json /tmp/killed-pending.json
    server_identity
    helper_alive
    KILL_PID=$SERVER_PID; KILL_START=$SERVER_START
    /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=1000 --regid=1000 --clear-groups /bin/busybox kill -KILL "$KILL_PID"
    echo "RUSTUSB_JOURNAL_SIGNAL: PASS signal=9 count=1 sender_uid=1000 pid=$KILL_PID starttime=$KILL_START"
    send_control 192.0.2.2 cycle-2-killed
    until_tick=$(( $(ticks) + 2000 ))
    while [ "$(ticks)" -lt "$until_tick" ]; do
        sysfs_observation
        if exited "$KILL_PID" && jq -e --slurpfile original /tmp/original-sysfs.json '.==$original[0]' /tmp/sysfs.json > /dev/null; then break; fi
        sleep 0.05
    done
    exited "$KILL_PID"
    if wait "$KILL_PID"; then code=0; else code=$?; fi
    jq -Mcn --arg epoch "$EPOCH" --argjson code "$code" --argjson pid "$KILL_PID" --argjson start "$KILL_START" '{label:$epoch,event:"server_wait",wait_code:$code,signal:9,signal_count:1,sender_uid:1000,pid:$pid,starttime:$start,final_backend_snapshot:null,final_backend_snapshot_observable:false}' >> /tmp/waits.jsonl
    printf 'RUSTUSB_JOURNAL_WAIT '; tail -n 1 /tmp/waits.jsonl
    [ "$code" = 137 ]
    [ ! -e "/proc/$KILL_PID" ]
    dump_epoch
    record killed-post
    records_count 2
    jq -e --slurpfile before /tmp/killed-pending.json '.records==$before[0].records' /tmp/pending.json > /dev/null
    # Both peers save their primary observations before this barrier. The
    # client waits here instead of sending into our full 20-second observation.
    send_control 192.0.2.2 cycle-2-server-observed
    receive_control cycle-2-observed
    STAGE=persistent-restart-refusal
    refused_server denied-before-helper-restart
    OLD_HELPER_PID=$HELPER_PID; OLD_HELPER_START=$HELPER_START
    helper_alive
    kill -TERM "$HELPER_PID"
    until_tick=$(( $(ticks) + 1000 ))
    while [ "$(ticks)" -lt "$until_tick" ]; do exited "$HELPER_PID" && break; sleep 0.05; done
    exited "$HELPER_PID"
    if wait "$HELPER_PID"; then helper_code=0; else helper_code=$?; fi
    [ "$helper_code" = 0 ] && [ ! -S /run/rustusb/control.sock ]
    cp /tmp/helper.log /tmp/helper-before-restart.log
    start_helper
    [ "$HELPER_PID" != "$OLD_HELPER_PID" ]
    jq -Mcn --argjson old "$OLD_HELPER_PID" --argjson oldstart "$OLD_HELPER_START" --argjson new "$HELPER_PID" --argjson newstart "$HELPER_START" --argjson code "$helper_code" '{event:"helper_restart",old_pid:$old,old_starttime:$oldstart,new_pid:$new,new_starttime:$newstart,old_wait_code:$code,state_directory_unchanged:true}' >> /tmp/waits.jsonl
    printf 'RUSTUSB_JOURNAL_WAIT '; tail -n 1 /tmp/waits.jsonl
    record helper-reloaded
    records_count 2
    jq -e --slurpfile before /tmp/killed-pending.json '.records==$before[0].records' /tmp/pending.json > /dev/null
    refused_server denied-after-helper-restart
    STAGE=unrestored-admin-refusal
    for lease in $(jq -r '.records[].lease_id' /tmp/killed-pending.json); do
        for uid in 1000 1001; do
            if /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid="$uid" --regid="$uid" --clear-groups /usr/bin/rustusb --json physical-pending > /tmp/api.json 2> /tmp/api-error.log; then api_code=0; else api_code=$?; fi
            if [ "$uid" = 1000 ]; then expected_error='physical pending records require root'; else expected_error='caller UID is not approved by the administrator'; fi
            admin_refusal "$api_code" "$expected_error"
            jq -Mcn --arg phase pending-denied --argjson uid "$uid" --argjson code "$api_code" --rawfile out /tmp/api.json --rawfile err /tmp/api-error.log '{phase:$phase,uid:$uid,exit_code:$code,stdout:$out,stderr:$err}' >> /tmp/admin-responses.jsonl
            if /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid="$uid" --regid="$uid" --clear-groups /usr/bin/rustusb --json physical-reconcile "$lease" > /tmp/api.json 2> /tmp/api-error.log; then api_code=0; else api_code=$?; fi
            if [ "$uid" = 1000 ]; then expected_error='physical reconciliation requires root'; else expected_error='caller UID is not approved by the administrator'; fi
            admin_refusal "$api_code" "$expected_error"
            jq -Mcn --arg phase reconcile-denied --argjson uid "$uid" --argjson code "$api_code" --arg lease "$lease" --rawfile out /tmp/api.json --rawfile err /tmp/api-error.log '{phase:$phase,uid:$uid,exit_code:$code,lease_id:$lease,stdout:$out,stderr:$err}' >> /tmp/admin-responses.jsonl
        done
        if /usr/bin/rustusb --json physical-reconcile "$lease" > /tmp/api.json 2> /tmp/api-error.log; then api_code=0; else api_code=$?; fi
        admin_refusal "$api_code" 'physical original configuration, full interface/alternate/driver set, or generation is not restored; unresolved grant retained'
        jq -Mcn --arg phase unrestored-refused --argjson code "$api_code" --arg lease "$lease" --rawfile out /tmp/api.json --rawfile err /tmp/api-error.log '{phase:$phase,uid:0,exit_code:$code,lease_id:$lease,stdout:$out,stderr:$err}' >> /tmp/admin-responses.jsonl
    done
    record unrestored-refused
    jq -e --slurpfile before /tmp/killed-pending.json '.records==$before[0].records' /tmp/pending.json > /dev/null
    STAGE=explicit-guest-admin-driver-restoration
    sysfs_observation
    jq -e --slurpfile original /tmp/original-sysfs.json 'length==2 and all(.[];.interfaces==[{number:0,alternate:0,driver:null}]) and map(del(.interfaces))==($original[0]|map(del(.interfaces)))' /tmp/sysfs.json > /dev/null
    printf '%s' "$HID_BUS:1.0" > /sys/bus/usb/drivers/usbhid/bind
    printf '%s' "$FTDI_BUS:1.0" > /sys/bus/usb/drivers/ftdi_sio/bind
    for attempt in $(seq 1 100); do
        sysfs_observation
        jq -e --slurpfile original /tmp/original-sysfs.json '.==$original[0]' /tmp/sysfs.json > /dev/null && break
        sleep 0.05
    done
    jq -e --slurpfile original /tmp/original-sysfs.json '.==$original[0]' /tmp/sysfs.json > /dev/null
    record guest-admin-restored
    records_count 2
    for lease in $(jq -r '.records[].lease_id' /tmp/killed-pending.json); do
        /usr/bin/rustusb --json physical-reconcile "$lease" > /tmp/api.json 2> /tmp/api-error.log
        jq -e '.status=="retired" and .observation=="restored"' /tmp/api.json > /dev/null
        jq -Mcn --arg phase restored-retired --arg lease "$lease" --rawfile out /tmp/api.json --rawfile err /tmp/api-error.log '{phase:$phase,uid:0,exit_code:0,lease_id:$lease,stdout:$out,stderr:$err}' >> /tmp/admin-responses.jsonl
    done
    record admin-retired
    records_count 0
    STAGE=authorized-after-reconcile

positive.after:
if [ "$AUTORESTORE_SCENARIO" = helper-restart ] && [ "$cycle" = 2 ]; then
            send_control 192.0.2.1 cycle-2-attached
            receive_control cycle-2-io-allowed
        fi
        timeout 8 dd bs=1 count=35 <&4 > /tmp/rx.bin 2> /tmp/dd.log & SERIAL_READER=$!
